name: agent-evaluation
description: Plan agent evaluation, write agent evals and regression tests, verify agent output and review eval results before release. Checks AI agent answers, saved artifacts, tool actions and human escalation against your own requirements, using action receipts and records rather than the agent's claim that it finished. Works from pasted traces, logs, configs, transcripts, files and existing runner exports; returns checks, eval case exports or findings that separate observed failures from missing evidence. Not for running agents or graders, collecting traces, importing datasets or deploying releases.
